title: Cloud Storage and Subdomain Takeover Analysis Rules

rules.name: Hardcoded public cloud storage bucket URL
rules.description: Hardcoded public cloud storage bucket URLs (s3.amazonaws.com, storage.googleapis.com, blob.core.windows.net) with write/list operations or unauthenticated access in Python code.
rules.remediation_example: url = s3_client.generate_presigned_url('get_object', Params={'Bucket': BUCKET, 'Key': key})  # use pre-signed URLs or signed IAM requests

rules.name: Subdomain takeover indicator on external cloud asset
rules.description: Web surface check for external script/iframe/link references pointing to unclaimed-prone cloud/PaaS hostnames (*.herokuapp.com, *.github.io, *.azurewebsites.net, *.s3.amazonaws.com) in HTML pages.
rules.remediation_example: Audit external cloud references and ensure third-party PaaS buckets and hostnames are actively claimed or hosted on verified first-party domains.
